title: 高盛卡普兰：通胀若持续，美联储9月前必须行动
speaker: Rob Kaplan

segments.en: If the inflation prints over the summer don't cool a little bit, they can maybe wait past the July meeting, but I think if they don't cool by September, I think there's going to be a lot of pressure on the Fed to take action to deliver that promised price stability.
segments.zh: 如果夏季通胀数据没有稍微降温，他们可以等到7月会议之后，但如果到9月仍未降温，我认为美联储将面临很大压力，需要采取行动以实现承诺的价格稳定。

segments.en: I don't think that's a market pressure. I think that's a reality pressure.
segments.zh: 我不认为那是市场压力，我认为那是现实压力。

segments.en: So they've got some time, but I don't know that they have a lot of time beyond September.
segments.zh: 所以他们还有一些时间，但我不知道9月之后他们是否还有很多时间。
